text:
sara.sales: Heads-up — ApertureCare just sent an RFP. They want a capability matrix, answers to the security questionnaire, and a short on-prem POC plan. PDF attached (see thread). They call out: dedicated capacity, customer-managed KMS/HSM, and data residency in eu-west-1. timeline = 4 weeks for POC.

mike-se: Got it. Do we have their target qps/latency requirements? also any dataset size/avg seq len?

sara.sales: They mentioned ~200 concurrent requests during business hours, 60 token avg prompt, 200 token responses. Latency target 300ms p50, 700ms p95.

mike-se: Ok that maps to a 2-GPU dedicated pool for a baseline, can autoscale to 4 for spikes. I'll draft a capability matrix showing throughput and SLOs.

anya-ops: For the on-prem eval: are they expecting we ship a VM image or run our private control plane in their VPC? They said "air-gapped friendly" in the questionnaire. :thinking_face:

sara.sales: They wrote "private deployment (customer-managed) with optional air-gapped setup" — sounds like we need both options spelled out.

mike-se: Suggest we provide two POC tracks in the matrix: 1) VPC-connected private deployment (console + agents) 2) air-gapped on-prem appliance (bundle + doc). Each with estimated lead times.

infra-bot: Checklist: SOC2 Type II (yes), FedRAMP (no), ISO27001 (partial), KMS/HSM integration (Y), customer-managed key rotation (Y), audit log export (Y), egress controls (Y). See /sales/rfps/templates for details.

chris-csm: Customer-facing ask: confirm what success looks like for them after the 4-week POC — throughput validated? latency SLOs? integration with their KMS? we should lock acceptance criteria up front.

dylan-legal: We'll need a DPA + addendum for the air-gapped deployment. Also confirm if they require an explicit subprocessor list. If they ask for HSM attestation we can provide our partner HSM certs.

anya-ops: For cleanup post-POC: add a data destruction checklist and a verification step (customer signs off). We should include sample runbook commands and an env teardown script.

mike-se: Draft capability matrix snippet (CSV) to include in response:
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private-onprem,airgapped
max-concurrent-reqs,500,2000,200,200
p50-latency,120ms,90ms,150ms,180ms
p95-latency,450ms,300ms,600ms,750ms
kms-support,managed,customer,key-via-connector,hsm-offline
data-residency,region,region,pinned,onsite
```

sara.sales: Perfect — Mike, can you turn that into the RFP matrix and attach a short POC runbook (2 pages) for the two tracks? Anya, can you author the teardown and data-destruction checklist. Dylan, please confirm DPA language we need to send. I'll coordinate with ApertureCare and ask for their acceptance criteria doc.

mike-se: Will do. ETA EOD tomorrow for the matrix and runbook draft.

anya-ops: I'll draft the teardown + verification steps by EOD today and include a short checklist for air-gapped steps (USB transfer fingerprinting, SHA256 manifests, manual key injection notes).

chris-csm: I'll confirm the customer success criteria with their PM, ask whether the POC should include a demo integration with their existing auth/KMS.

infra-bot: Artifact reminder: attach RFP PDF, security questionnaire (ApertureCare_SEC_Q_v1.pdf), and the signed MSA placeholder if available.

dylan-legal: Quick note — we'll need to push a standard DPA + bespoke clause for customer-managed HSM responsibilities. I'll add a short redline and send to Sara for customer review.

sara.sales: Thanks all. I'll post the ApertureCare RFP PDF here and set up a follow-up call with their infra lead for Wednesday 10am UTC. Please flag any blockers before then. :thumbsup:

mike-se: Flag — if they insist on p95 < 500ms in air-gapped mode we may need extra perf tuning and a heavier machine spec. I'll note that in the matrix.

anya-ops: Also flag: if they require FIPS-only crypto on the appliance image, we need security approvals and extra build time (~2 weeks).

chris-csm: Noted. I'll surface both potential blockers in the kickoff call and try to get clarity on acceptance criteria.

sara.sales: Call scheduled and PDF uploaded. I'll update thread with attachments. Thanks everyone.
